mechanism: Every qualifying original line receives a request-local L ID; selected IDs resolve to literal original text, source passage ID, source path and absolute source line number. The resolver does not normalize or repair model-written quotations; the model selects lines instead. Shared validator still checks resolved references.
heading_exclusion: Markdown headings, bracket-prefixed disclosures and very short lines have null IDs. Some list labels may still be selectable; semantic support must be reviewed.
raw_evidence: Raw model line selections and complete line catalog are saved alongside resolved citations.
proof_boundary: Selection validity ensures provenance/quote identity, not semantic entailment or completeness.
